name: com.ppftec/eubinder
title: EuBinder – EU rules for online shops
description: EU rules for online shops: obligations checklist, packaging registers, GPSR and accessibility drafts

tools.name: list_markets_and_categories
tools.description: Which EU countries, product categories (for example toys, cosmetics, electronics, textiles, food) and packaging register countries EuBinder covers, plus every rule_id with its title: the values that eu_obligations_checklist, explain_obligation and epr_packaging_register_lookup accept, and the optional business questions with their answer types. It lists values only; it does not work out which rules apply to a shop.

tools.name: eu_obligations_checklist
tools.description: EU rules for an online shop: which EU and national obligations may apply to a web shop or marketplace seller selling into the EU, such as GPSR product safety and the EU responsible person, toys and cosmetics, packaging (PPWR, EPR registration), accessibility (European Accessibility Act), the online withdrawal button, customs on parcels from outside the EU and B2B e-invoicing (for example KSeF in Poland). Input: the EU countries the shop sells or ships to; optional: where the business is established (also outside the EU, for example China or the US), product categories and answers such as dropshipping from non-EU suppliers. Each rule comes with its status, start date, deadline, what to prepare and official sources with verification dates, plus follow-up questions. Sector rules are included for toys (Toy Safety Directive) and cosmetics (Cosmetics Regulation) only. It does not cover other product sectors, VAT or other taxes, data protection, or an assessment of a specific product. General information, not legal advice.

ships_to.description: EU countries the shop sells or ships to (target markets), as ISO codes, e.g. ["DE","FR","AT"] for Germany, France and Austria

establishment_country.description: Country where the business or seller is established, as an ISO code; may be outside the EU, e.g. "CN" (China), "US", "GB" or "CH"

product_categories.description: Product categories sold, as keys from list_markets_and_categories, e.g. toys, cosmetics, electronics, textiles, food, general_consumer

ships_physical_goods.description: Sells physical goods that are shipped to customers (false if the shop sells only digital products or services)

sells_b2c.description: Sells to consumers (B2C, private customers); default true

sells_b2b.description: Sells to businesses (B2B customers); used for the e-invoicing rules

enterprise_size.description: Business size (SME size class): micro, small, medium or large

ppwr_role.description: Role for packaging under the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR), if known

has_non_eu_manufacturer.description: Some products are made by a manufacturer outside the EU, e.g. bought from non-EU suppliers, imported or dropshipped from China

ships_from_outside_eu.description: Some orders reach EU customers from outside the EU, e.g. from a non-EU warehouse or dropshipped from a non-EU supplier (customs on low-value parcels)

food_contact_packaging.description: Some packaging is in direct contact with food

nl_packaging_above_50t.description: Netherlands: places more than 50,000 kg of packaging on the Dutch market in a calendar year

vat_registered_in.description: EU countries where the business is registered for VAT, as ISO codes

tools.name: explain_obligation
tools.description: Explains one EU or national rule in detail, for example the PPWR authorised representative for packaging, the PPWR declaration of conformity, the GPSR EU responsible person, the EUR 3 customs duty on low-value parcels, KSeF or Spanish B2B e-invoicing, the online withdrawal button, toy warnings or the cosmetics responsible person: what it requires, who must do it, where it applies, start date and deadline, whether a change or postponement of the law is pending, open questions and official sources. Input: a rule_id as listed by list_markets_and_categories or returned by eu_obligations_checklist (for example eu-ppwr-epr-authorised-representative). It explains one known rule; it does not work out which rules apply to a shop.

rule_id.description: Rule identifier, e.g. "eu-ppwr-epr-authorised-representative", "eu-gpsr-responsible-person" or "pl-einvoice-ksef"; listed by list_markets_and_categories and returned by eu_obligations_checklist

tools.name: epr_packaging_register_lookup
tools.description: Where to register packaging in one EU country, for example LUCID in Germany, the UIN (IDU) from SYDEREP in France, BDO in Poland, Verpact in the Netherlands or EDM in Austria (national packaging register, extended producer responsibility or EPR): the register name, operator, official URL and the registration number a seller shows, with notes and sources. Covers DE, FR, NL, IT, ES, RO, PL, AT, BE, CZ, SE and DK; entries not confirmed on an official page are marked unverified. Registers for batteries, electrical equipment or textiles are not covered.

country.description: EU country as a two-letter ISO code, e.g. "DE" (Germany), "FR" (France), "PL" (Poland), "NL" (Netherlands)

tools.name: gpsr_product_page_block
tools.description: Writes the GPSR product safety information for an online product page or marketplace listing: manufacturer name and address, EU responsible person, importer, product identifier, warnings and safety information, as listed in GPSR Article 19. Output as HTML and plain text in English, German, French, Dutch, Italian, Spanish, Polish or Romanian (for example the Herstellerangaben block in German), with points to check, including the product picture. Uses only the details given; nothing is stored. It does not judge whether a product is safe and does not choose the responsible person.

language.description: Language of the block: en, de, fr, nl, it, es, pl or ro

name.description: Name, registered trade name or registered trade mark

contact_url.description: Electronic contact address as a URL (e.g. contact form), if no e-mail

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer (maker or brand owner) with postal and electronic address

responsible_person.description: EU responsible person (an economic operator established in the EU, e.g. the importer or an authorised representative); needed when the manufacturer is not established in the EU

name.description: Name, registered trade name or registered trade mark

contact_url.description: Electronic contact address as a URL (e.g. contact form), if no e-mail

name.description: Name, registered trade name or registered trade mark

contact_url.description: Electronic contact address as a URL (e.g. contact form), if no e-mail

manufacturer_established_in_eu.description: Whether the manufacturer is established in the EU

product_identifier.description: Type, model, batch, SKU or EAN

warnings.description: Warnings, e.g. age or choking warnings, as on the product or packaging

safety_information.description: Safety information or instructions for safe use

safety_documents.description: Links (https) to safety documents, e.g. instructions or a safety data sheet

tools.name: accessibility_statement_draft
tools.description: Writes a draft accessibility statement for a web shop or online store under the European Accessibility Act (EAA, Annex V; in Germany the BFSG, where it is often called Barrierefreiheitserklärung), in Markdown: service description, how it works, measures, status, known issues, feedback contact, and the market surveillance authorities on file for the selected EU countries (a visible placeholder where none is verified). Uses only the answers given; nothing is stored. It does not test or scan a website.

store_name.description: Name of the web shop or online store

service_description.description: Annex V (a): general description of the online store

service_operation.description: Annex V (b): how the service works, as needed to understand it

measures.description: Annex V (c): measures taken to meet the accessibility requirements

status.description: How far the store meets the accessibility requirements so far

manual_checks.description: Manual accessibility checks done, with dates (keyboard only, visible focus, zoom and reflow, text alternatives, video captions, form errors, consistent navigation, no time limits)

known_issues.description: Known accessibility problems, with WCAG success criteria, impact and planned fix date

feedback_url.description: Contact form URL for accessibility feedback

markets.description: EU countries where the store sells; used to list the market surveillance authorities on file
